title: Dominari Holdings and the Trump sons' small-cap network
summary: The core facts hold: Don Jr. and Eric Trump joined Trump Tower-based Dominari Holdings as advisers on Feb. 10-11, 2025. Each took about a 6.7% stake (roughly 13% combined) through share grants and a $3.47 private placement, and DOMH soared. Dominari co-formed American Data Centers/American Bitcoin with them and co-led their SPAC's IPO, with president Kyle Wool on the SPAC board. The claim overreaches in two places. Most of DOMH's spike came before the announcement. Thumzup and GrabAGun fell rather than spiked on the Trump news. No SEC or FINRA action against Dominari or the sons is documented; the scrutiny on record is a March 2026 House China committee letter on Dominari's Chinese IPOs and a 2026 FINRA fine on Wool's former firm, Revere.

sub_claims.statement: Don Jr. and Eric Trump became advisers to and major shareholders of Dominari Holdings.
sub_claims.finding: Advisory agreements date to Feb. 10, 2025, with an initial grant of 250,000 shares each. Each brother also bought about $1M in the $13.5M placement priced at $3.47 per unit. 13G filings show 966,138 shares each (6.71%) as of Feb. 21, 2025, plus 432,276 warrant shares each, putting each near 10% fully diluted. Their exact cost basis is not disclosed. Barron's noted the 13Gs excluded the 432,276 warrant shares as 'not currently exercisable due to certain beneficial ownership limitations', which kept each brother below the 10% insider threshold.

sub_claims.statement: Dominari's stock soared after the Trump sons arrived.
sub_claims.finding: DOMH was under $1 in December 2024. It rose about 529-580% in the six weeks before the Feb. 11 announcement, jumped as much as 84% on the day, and gained about 300% in the week. Forbes found daily volume went from about 11,500 to about 1.2M shares from Dec. 30; TipRanks gave different figures (under 2,000 to over 200,000 shares in the days before), so volume numbers vary by outlet and window. Most of the spike preceded the public news. The stock ended 2025 just under $5.

sub_claims.statement: Dominari is based in Trump Tower.
sub_claims.finding: It has two leases on Trump Tower floors 22-23, totaling more than $62,000 a month, two floors below the Trump Organization's headquarters. It is a former biotech (Spherix/AIkido) that pivoted to brokerage.

sub_claims.statement: Dominari co-founded American Data Centers/American Bitcoin with the Trump sons.
sub_claims.finding: Dominari held about 32% of ADC, which later became American Bitcoin (see C18). It held about 23.2M ABTC shares, worth about $170M at the September 2025 listing, and reported selling its ABTC investment in January 2026 for $32.4M in cash. Whether that was the full stake is unclear.

sub_claims.statement: Dominari co-underwrote the Trump sons' SPAC, and its president Kyle Wool sits on the SPAC board.
sub_claims.finding: Dominari Securities and D. Boral Capital led New America Acquisition I's $345M IPO (December 2025). Wool is on its board and advisory board (see C27).

sub_claims.statement: The sons made large gains via Dominari-linked deals.
sub_claims.finding: Bloomberg said Wool helped them make 'more than half a billion dollars,' mostly the peak paper value of American Bitcoin, which has since fallen more than 90%. In May 2025 they could sell a combined $9.6M of Dominari stock registered for resale. No sale of their Dominari shares is confirmed, and MarketWatch corrected an erroneous sale report.

sub_claims.statement: Dominari's business boomed after the sons joined.
sub_claims.finding: Q2 2025 revenue rose 452% to $34M. Underwriting revenue rose about six-fold in 2025. CEO Anthony Hayes (about $34M) and Wool (about $32M) took roughly $66M in 2025 pay. Dominari also arranged the SRM/Tron reverse-merger financing, after which SRM rose more than 500% and the position it arranged showed more than $120M in paper gains. In 2026 it built the $1B American Ventures vehicle, in which the sons invested, with paper gains on microcaps.

sub_claims.statement: Unusual Machines: a Trump son's arrival preceded a share-price spike.
sub_claims.finding: Don Jr. joined the advisory board on Nov. 27, 2024. UMAC rose more than 220% in the prior four weeks and rose again on the news. Dominari was placement agent for its $40M (May 2025) and $48.5M (July 2025) offerings and co-agent on a roughly $150M offering in March 2026 (see C32).

sub_claims.statement: Thumzup: a Trump son's arrival preceded a share-price spike.
sub_claims.finding: Don Jr.'s 350,000-share (about $4M) stake was disclosed in July 2025, after a $6M Dominari-arranged preferred placement. The stock fell more than 14% that day. Dominari then ran a $50M offering at $10 a share, and by September insiders were buying at about $5.16. No Eric Trump stake was found.

sub_claims.statement: GrabAGun/Colombier II: a Trump son's arrival preceded a share-price spike.
sub_claims.finding: GrabAGun merged with Omeed Malik's Colombier II, raised about $179M and listed as PEW in July 2025. Don Jr. is on the board with about 300,000 shares (about $3M). The stock fell about 20-24% on debut and about 30% in two days. No Dominari role was found. The House CCP committee's letters went to three underwriters: Dominari (11 of 29 IPOs), Revere (12 of 40) and D. Boral Capital (10 of 30+), the last being Dominari's co-lead on the sons' SPAC IPO.

sub_claims.statement: Dominari or the Trump sons face SEC or FINRA scrutiny.
sub_claims.finding: No SEC or FINRA action, charge or disclosed investigation involving Dominari or the sons was found. The pre-announcement trading was flagged only by media and experts. The scrutiny on record is a House Select Committee on the CCP letter (Moolenaar/Khanna, around March 8, 2026) citing 11 of Dominari's 29 Chinese IPOs that collapsed; Dominari said it would cooperate. FINRA fined Revere Securities, which Wool led from 2022, $800,000 in 2026 for small-cap IPO AML failures, without admission; overlap with Wool's tenure is unverified. Historic Barry Honig links to predecessor Spherix come from one newsletter.

corrections: The claim implies the stock soared after the sons arrived. Most of DOMH's surge (about 530-580%) happened in the six weeks before the Feb. 11, 2025 announcement.
The claim says Thumzup and GrabAGun spiked after a Trump son arrived. Thumzup fell more than 14% on the stake disclosure, and GrabAGun fell about 30% in its first two days.
GrabAGun/Colombier II is an Omeed Malik deal; no Dominari role was found.
No SEC or FINRA scrutiny of Dominari or the sons is documented. The scrutiny is a congressional letter (March 2026) and a FINRA fine on Revere, Wool's former firm.
The 'half a billion dollars' gain is mostly paper value at American Bitcoin's peak, and that stock later fell more than 90%.
denials_and_context: Dominari: it had 'no reason to believe that any of these people breached any duty, whether legal or fiduciary' and did not know why investors bought before the announcement.
Dominari spokesman Brett Maas (May 2025): neither advisers nor investors had sold shares.
The sons call themselves passive investors in American Ventures, with no operating role and no dealings with federal agencies for its portfolio companies.
Eric Trump denied any role in Dominari's Tron/SRM deal.
Trump Organization: suggestions of the brothers' involvement in the Kazakhstan tungsten award are 'categorically false, misleading and libelous'; their Skyline stake predated the deal.
Dominari, on the House CCP letter: IPOs were under 10% of its banking revenue, and it ended Chinese IPO work in 2024 and Hong Kong IPO work in mid-2025.
Former White House ethics officials (WSJ) warn that the network lets investors with business before the government bet on the family's interests.
Most primary pages (Bloomberg, WSJ, FT, Barron's, House committee PDF) were not read directly; findings rely on search excerpts and syndicated copies.
